rows.note: Use this as the everyday all-purpose noun for an active dispute or quarrel.

example.english: I don't want any more dissension with you over these little things.
example.traditional: 我唔想再同你為呢啲小事爭拗喇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 soeng2 zoi3 tung4 nei5 wai6 ni1 di1 siu2 si6 zang1 aau3 laa3

rows.note: Use this when the disagreement is a difference of views between sides rather than an actual quarrel.

example.english: We have dissension over this proposal, but we can still work together.
example.traditional: 我哋喺呢個方案上有分歧，但仲可以合作。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 hai2 ni1 go3 fong1 on3 soeng6 jau5 fan1 kei4 daan6 zung6 ho2 ji5 hap6 zok3

rows.note: Use this for publicly or collectively voiced opposition, especially when dissent is expressed aloud.

example.english: As soon as the plan was announced, a lot of dissension emerged in the community.
example.traditional: 呢個計劃一宣布，社區入面就出現咗好多反對聲音。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 jat1 syun1 bou3 se5 keoi1 jap6 min6 zau6 ceot1 jin6 zo2 hou2 do1 faan2 deoi3 sing1 jam1
